description: Schematic 3D kinematic replay of saved UR5e high-resolution review qpos. World coordinates were extracted by mj_forward through the exact portable review MJModel; this is not a CAD mesh or a newly simulated trajectory.
labelLimitations: The selected cases are outcome-conditioned representatives from fixed constructed adversarial roots, not samples from an untouched natural-scene distribution.
Saved review outcomes and gate decisions are copied verbatim and were not recomputed for this export.
The NPZ stores aggregate high-resolution replay collision flags in the accompanying review JSON, not per-frame collision markers.
Body and joint coordinates are forward-kinematic positions from recorded qpos; no new dynamics integration, training, seed selection, or gate evaluation was performed.
The replay is schematic and does not embed or approximate the UR5e CAD meshes.

sampling.timestampDefinition: Each saved qpos follows 50 simulation steps at dt=0.001 s; timeIndex 0 is therefore t=0.05 s.
